BMP 2.1
Dry Weather
Screening

Conduct visual dry
weather screening
of the City’s storm
water outfalls
Year 1

*Develop dry weather
screening procedures
and train appropriate
personnel.
*Assess the City’s
outfalls and determine
target areas for outfall
inspections. Target areas
will include all outfalls
that discharge to creeks.
Quarterly or monthly
inspection, of companies
that fall within 1000 feet
of a drainage area.

BMP 2.2
Illicit Discharge
Inspection

Conduct inspections
to determine the
source of Illicit
connection and
illegal dumping
activities.
Year 1

*Develop standard
inspection procedures
and train appropriate
personnel.

BMP 2.3
Storm Sewer
System Map

Develop a storm sewer
map in accordance
with TCEQ
requirements.
Year 1-2

*Mapping information for the
City’s storm drainage system
is being collected. A storm
drainage map will be
prepared from this data,
identifying discharge points
and drainage throughout the
city and identifying the bad
points.
Year 3-5

*Continue the existing
program of
triggering/completing storm
sewer mapping changes as
permits and as building plans
are filed for new construction
activities.
* All outfalls and names of
surface waters receiving
discharges from the outfalls
will be completed.

BMP 3.2
Receipt and
Consideration of
Information from
Public

Develop and
implement a
program for the
receipt and
consideration of
public comments
regarding erosion
control.
Year 1-2

*Develop a system for
receiving, considering, and
tracking comments from the
public regarding the City’s
erosion control program and
for specific project-related
complaints.
*Begin implementation of the
system.

BMP 3.3
Complaints

Develop and
implement a
program for
complaints
Year 2-5

*Develop a tracking log
for complaints which
counts them and reveals
locations.

BMP 5.1
Storm Sewer
Cleaning

Remove floatable,
debris, sediment,
etc. from inlets and
pipes as needed to
maintain capacity
and to reduce storm
water pollution.
Year 1-2

*Develop a schedule for
conducting a visual
inspection of the City’s
storm drainage inlets.
*Develop a system to
monitor and track storm
sewer cleaning activities.
*Clean system as needed in
response to complaints or
reported problems.
